source_limits: Same-root source review with key, literal, language and both frozen readings visible. Complete eleven-unit Czech/English working passage is provisional, not independently confirmed or solved. Two rotated regions I→II and small signature continuation retain a proposed spatial route, not writing chronology.

This edition explicitly distinguishes a base-only decoder projection from a complete diplomatic transcription. Fifty-eight original unresolved upper-form codepoint contexts remain separately unresolved: 42 combining codepoints and 16 precomposed groups. No mark has been deciphered, authenticated as linguistic accent, or certified noncipher merely by moving it outside the base replay. All original codepoints remain in frozen evidence and exact previous-offset dispositions. These are notation-context records, not 58 physical marks or an inventory of all ink.

Selected base replay has 11 rows/299 notation slots/298 known emitted letters/one CH/two encoded unknowns. Prior full notation replay had 341/282/one CH/60 unknowns. Net−42 slots comes solely from explicit combining-annotation separation; 16 precomposed groups receive provisional base choices, increasing known base emissions by 16. This is representation bookkeeping, not 58 newly deciphered bodies or physical deletion. No Unicode normalization/decomposition, key change, generic accented-letter/roof alias or physical census.

Each of 58 base/annotation decisions is explicit by original line/offset and current base context; combining marks retain their original codepoints and provisional preceding-base context, without certifying attachment. Precomposed ś→s/C, ć→c/S and ĩ→1/Y are occurrence-bound source-family hypotheses after viewing the panels, not universal aliases. Two unresolved codepoints remain in replay: R03 terminal = and R08 v. Whole source forms remain available in the preceding edition and native records.

R08 literal ZOvI NSZEHO stays unresolved. Proposed Chopinského requires language-only Z→CH, unknown v→P, Z→K and a word-space join. No source ř/CH or P is added. This is only a conjectural textual form, not identification of a composer, work, performance, quotation or event. Existing ř in R06 CHUTI stays unchanged/provisional; no generic roof→CH rule.

R09 literal VZOMINAM remains, with P inserted only in the proposed language. No encoded P added from grammar or upper traces. Repeated source Z retained for proposed K in DIZ/LISTZY/LISTZU/ANDILZY/LICZA/JAZA/DIZTOVALA/LISTEZ/VZPOMINZY/VALCIZU/NICZO. R07/R08 standalone Z→K and R08 NELREBA L→T are likewise language-only. All altered word forms and operations are recorded with exact literal spans.

Three cross-unit word joins retain source distinctions: NEJROZTOMILEJ=/SI uses an unresolved terminal =, not a certified source hyphen; ANDU-/LICZA retains one actual selected source hyphen; PSA/NICZO has no selected source hyphen. The last two propose Andulička and psaníčko with Z→K only after joining. Names/signature are textual proposals, not authenticated identity or authorship. .g sentence spacing/case and Czech diacritics are editorial, not additional cipher values.

One actual R06 written question remains punctuation, rebased from previous offset 13 to current 12 after separating an earlier combining annotation. Exact previous question-role record retained through a new bounded mapping; no masks or ordinary numeral tags. English reorders the seventh/little-angels sentence and signature clause; pronouns, affect, relationship, six/seventh referents, waltz/memory response and actual events remain unverified. Printed illustration/caption and ordinary date-like writing are not used to authenticate those referents or date the message.
